app.name: Tambat
app.headline: Prove that one person holds a Bitcoin Cash wallet and a Nostr key.
app.sub: Sign with both keys, publish the proof to Nostr relays, and let anyone check it without trusting this site.

how.title: How it works
how.one: Your Nostr key publishes a NIP-39 identity event that names your BCH address.
how.two: Your BCH wallet signs a message naming your npub, so neither key can claim the other alone.
how.three: Anyone fetches the event from relays and checks both signatures on their own device.

verifier.title: Verify a BCH and Nostr binding
verifier.intro: This page is a single HTML file. It checks every signature in your browser and talks only to the relays listed below, never to the Tambat server. Save it and open it from disk to check bindings without this site.
verifier.inputLabel: Signed event JSON, npub or BCH address
verifier.inputHelp: Paste a kind 10011 event to check it on this device, or enter an npub or address to fetch the newest binding from relays.
verifier.relaysHelp: One per line. Edit them freely; nothing else is contacted.
verifier.pastedNote: Checked on this device without relays. The newest-event step needs relays, so it is skipped.
verifier.none: No binding was found on these relays.
verifier.badJson: This is not valid JSON. Details: {reason}
verifier.badRelays: Each relay must start with ws:// or wss://. Check: {relay}
verifier.trust: No server is involved: the checks run here, with code from the same open source library as the app.
verifier.downloadHelp: Check bindings without this site: one HTML file that talks only to relays.

crit.correctness: Technical correctness: every check is named and has a failing test
crit.security: Security: one key cannot sign both sides, sign-in nonces work once
crit.decentralization: Decentralization: relays are untrusted; one down, look-ups still verify
crit.interop: Interoperability: NIP-39, Bitcoin signed messages, did:nostr, BIP21
crit.usability: Usability: English and Malay, phone and desktop, Paytaca over WalletConnect
crit.demo: Demo quality: live on public relays, every claim measured
